explanation:

• ১ম রাশি: $x^2 - y^2 = (x - y)(x + y)$
• ২য় রাশি: $x^2 + xy + y^2$
• ৩য় রাশি: $x^3 - y^3 = (x - y)(x^2 + xy + y^2)$

explanation:

$$(x + y - z)^2 = x^2 + y^2 + z^2 + 2(xy - yz - zx)$$
• মান বসিয়ে পাই:
$$8^2 = 4 + 2(xy - yz - zx)$$
$$64 - 4 = 2(xy - yz - zx) \implies 60 = 2(xy - yz - zx)$$
$$xy - yz - zx = 30$$
• অতএব $yz - zx - xy = -30$।
